title: Passengers
evidence: Publisher page credits Robert Silverberg and displays the story from the fractured memory opening through the final scene in the cocktail lounge. The credited Michael Spence audio is a separate untested lead.

title: The Beast that Shouted Love at the Heart of the World
evidence: English page names Harlan Ellison and displays the complete story from William Sterog through Friedrich Drucker and the final war. Rehost permission unverified.

title: Mother to the World
evidence: English transcription names Richard Wilson. It opens with the scientific mission and ends with Adam and his parents by the stream. Rehost permission unverified.

title: Aye, and Gomorrah
evidence: Guest PDF identifies Samuel R. Delany and includes the story through the final scene. Permission for the college-hosted copy is unverified.

title: "Repent, Harlequin!" Said the Ticktockman
evidence: English story page credits Harlan Ellison and labels the text original; it runs through the Ticktockman's final exchange. Permission for the rehost is unverified.

title: That Hell-Bound Train
pub: The Magazine of Fantasy & Science Fiction, September 1958
evidence: Guest standalone PDF credits Robert Bloch and includes Martin's story through the final train scene. Permission for the rehost is unverified.

title: Or All the Seas with Oysters
evidence: The author estate hosts the English story from the bicycle shop opening through the final conversation, followed by the estate copyright notice.
